data.title: Thailand’s Jeeno tied for lead at Hawaii event
data.description: HONOLULU, Hawaii - Jeeno ​Thitikul of Thailand and Polly ⁠Mack of Germany each ⁠birdied the final hole on Friday ​to share the lead after the second round of the Lotte Championship in Honolulu.

data.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile after Seoul's apology demand
data.description: SEOUL - North Korea fired a ballistic missile, Seoul's military said Saturday, days after demanding an apology for a blast that wounded three South Korean soldiers in the DMZ that it blames on the North.

data.title: China a better influence in Latin America than US: poll
data.description: BOGOTá - China's influence in Latin America is now viewed more positively than that of the United States, a major poll conducted in 17 Latin American countries showed Friday.

data.title: US regulator finds Boeing 737 MAX software bug 'not a safety concern'
data.description: NEW YORK - A software bug that delayed the US certification of Boeing's 737 MAX 10 aircraft does not pose a safety concern, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) said Friday after an investigation.

data.title: Cornell rape case exposes sexual violence at US colleges
data.description: NEW YORK - An alleged gang rape at Cornell University, detailed in a graphic lawsuit last month, has provoked fury in the United States over sexual violence on campuses and colleges' failure to stamp out the behavior.

data.title: New rallies urged in France as protests disrupt 730 schools
data.description: PARIS - French high school students on Friday lit fires and hurled projectiles at police who responded by firing tear gas, as activists urged new rallies in an escalating protest movement demanding better conditions in education.

data.title: Local lessons for the People’s Party
data.description: The defeat of the People’s Party in the Sept 20 election for chairman of the Nonthaburi Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) highlights a familiar but noteworthy question for the main opposition: how effectively can its strong national popularity be translated into votes in local contests?

data.title: Oily film in Prachin Buri floodwaters investigated
data.description: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has ordered the Pollution Control Department (PCD) to urgently investigate an iridescent film resembling used lubricating oil found in floodwaters in Prachin Buri.

data.title: Health is wealth
data.description: Sanvi Mandal of Nepal has been crowned Miss Wellness World 2026, taking the top title at the international pageant finals held in Bangkok under the theme "Beauty With Wellness".

data.title: Royals fans still love their gem now worth his weight in gold
data.description: For many years, supporters of lower league clubs in England have become resigned to witnessing their most promising players being snapped up by bigger clubs for relatively small sums. It is very frustrating for the fans, but it's the way the system works.

data.title: Two hurt in petrol station blast
data.description: Narathiwat: A bomb exploded at a PT petrol station in Tak Bai district on Thursday night, damaging fuel pumps and the station building and injuring two employees, authorities said.
